title: Chess Trainer
prompt: Build a polished browser chess trainer app with a legal chess board, drag-and-drop and click-to-move input, move legality, check/checkmate/stalemate detection, legal move highlighting, move history in algebraic notation, board flip, undo/redo, FEN import/export, PGN export, a small puzzle mode with feedback, and responsive design. The result must run locally without paid services.
acceptanceCriteria: All standard chess pieces move legally, including castling, en passant, promotion, check, checkmate, and stalemate handling.
Illegal moves are rejected with clear visual feedback and do not corrupt board state.
Users can move pieces by drag-and-drop and click-to-move on desktop and touch-sized screens.
Legal move highlighting, check indication, move history, undo/redo, board flip, and restart are visible and correct.
FEN import/export and PGN export work for normal game positions and reject invalid FEN safely.
Puzzle mode presents at least three tactical positions, validates the solution move, and explains success or failure.
Project includes run instructions and automated or scripted sanity checks for chess rules and import/export.
requiredArtifacts: preview URL or local run command
